2026_01_ARI_LAC.headline: Arizona’s new offense meets a Chargers front built to force uncomfortable downs
2026_01_ARI_LAC.paragraph1: Arizona arrives with optimism around Mike LaFleur’s offense and a deep skill group, but the Cardinals are missing guard Isaiah Adams and corner Garrett Williams while Jeremiyah Love remains questionable. That raises the importance of clean early downs for Jacoby Brissett and Trey McBride. Los Angeles counters with Justin Herbert in Mike McDaniel’s new scheme and a defense that can pressure Arizona if the Cardinals fall behind the sticks, making protection and down-to-down efficiency the matchup’s central stress point.
2026_01_ARI_LAC.model_rationale: Los Angeles can create pressure if Arizona is forced into obvious passing situations, while the Cardinals’ best counter is efficient early-down offense and quick distribution to their strongest targets.
